title: Time evolution of a Nambu-Goto string coiling around a Kerr black hole
summary: The interaction between a Nambu-Goto string and a Kerr black hole gives one of the methods of energy extraction from a rotating black hole. Although the properties of such processes have been well studied for rigidly rotating strings, little is known for non-rigidly rotating strings. In this paper, we study time evolution of a Nambu-Goto string on the equatorial plane of a Kerr spacetime, which sticks on the horizon and extends to spatial infinity.
